task_definition.task_description: Please check the NASDAQ market status and get the current stock data for AAPL. Resolve its direct quote profile, and then place a buy order for $170.25. Once that is done, fetch the balance sheet for my checking account (user_123) and publish it to me via a high-priority email. After handling the finances, scan for smart devices in my living room, check the current status of the living room light, build a brightness request for 80%, and update the device configuration to set the brightness to 80. Finally, use the balance data to create a "Trade and Balance Report" document tagged with "finance" and "trade", and send me a medium-priority alert about it through the app.
